title: Chapter 285 The Frustrated Demon Wolf King
content:
Chapter 285 The Frustrated Demon Wolf King

After realizing that he had been fooled, the Demon Wolf King quickly condensed a layer of ice all over his body.

The swamp under his feet was quickly frozen.

The green vines under the mountain were also frozen.

Then, he shook his whole body, and the vines became ice chips and scattered all over the ground.

But the bronze spear had already shot, and he had no time to dodge, so he could only take the blow.

The first spear was directly swept away.

The second spear hit the ice armor and was broken.

But it also left a small hole the size of a thumb on the ice armor.

Then, more spears pierced his body.

Finally, his whole body defense was shattered, and the spears behind pierced into his body.

"Ah, woo!... woo!"

He wailed in pain on the ice, his voice was shrill, and the ice and fire on his body kept flashing, as if he was repairing his damaged body.

Wang Shuo and others saw this opportunity and did not hesitate at all. If not now, when would they go?

Wang Shuo used his legs to leap up, and in mid-air, he used his strongest attack.

At the same time, Good and Ayub also used their strongest skills.

The Demon Wolf King turned his head and saw three attacks falling on him one after another. His terrible wounds quickly worsened, and his health dropped to less than 2,000.

However, this was not the end. In the distance, a huge stone man crashed into him.

"Mount Tai pressed down on the top"

The Demon Wolf King was immediately stunned.

At the same time, the ice layer on the ground was cracked, and the Demon Wolf King slowly sank half of his body into the swamp while dizzy.

It was not silt below, but hard frozen soil.

But none of this mattered, and this gave several people another chance to attack.

Although everyone's ultimate move was gone, there were other high-damage skills.

Wang Shuo also fought hard. If this attack could not kill him, it would most likely let the Demon Wolf King escape.

In the future, I am afraid there will be no chance to kill him again.

Wang Shuo directly took out 20 thunder bombs and threw them into the pit.

"Bang."

After a loud bang, the soil was blown up.

However, the sound that Wang Shuo wanted to hear did not sound.

Wang Shuo and Ayub stood 20 meters away, looking at each other.

"Is he dead?"

Wang Shuo had no idea.

In theory, 20 thunderbolts can cause 20,000 damage, which is enough.

Although the defense of the Demon Wolf King is 1200, he is now seriously injured and his defense has been greatly reduced.

Wang Shuo approached cautiously.

At the edge of the deep pit that was blown up, Wang Shuo saw the situation in the pit.

The limbs of the Demon Wolf King were blown away, and half of his head was blown off.

However, in the other half of the head, there was still death energy condensed into a ball, which was constantly absorbing the death energy around and repairing the damaged body.

Wang Shuo breathed a sigh of relief, and at the same time he had to praise.

"Awesome."

He was not dead, so Wang Shuo was not polite. He waited for a while, and when the big move CD was ready, he directly gave him a fatal blow.

[You killed the Demon Wolf King...]

Wang Shuo finally felt relieved after hearing the system prompt.

The Demon Wolf King's fall was extremely frustrating. He didn't have time to release many skills before he was killed by Wang Shuo!

It can only be said that fighting cannot rely on force alone, but also requires a little strategy.

The Demon Wolf King dropped many items, including a lot of soul crystals and energy crystals.

One of the job transfer certificates made Wang Shuo very excited.

[High-level military officer job transfer certificate]

Wang Shuo immediately used this job transfer certificate.

Just now, he killed the Demon Wolf King, and his level has risen to level 38.

The high-level military officer's momentum burst out, and Wang Shuo felt stronger than ever before.

"Ah,..."

"I-want-to-beat-10-of-them,..."
